line.text: 'Recycling a ship unlocks some research toward its blueprint.'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.3: Insane mode reduces recycle factor by 20%.
* Mordan9 - Better default recycling from Capital Shipyard.
* Expanded 2.2: Changed from 1.2x to 1.15x.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Get the number of planets with the recycler effect. Each recycler gives 10% more recycling factor and 10% more research, stacking additively with other recyclers.
* Add-Ons 1.4.5: Patch exploit where missile and lasers that come with ships can be recycled for net profit in crystals and silicon (defeats the purpose of making silicon mines).
* Recycle factor when recycling lasers and missiles is 1/6 of the normal recycle factor. For OCV lasers, 1/100 of the normal recycling factor.
* Display recycling yields to one decimal place.
* OCV lasers (Add-Ons 1.14: also for shields)

line.text: 'Recycling yield for most lasers and missiles: '
'Recycling yield for shields and OCV lasers: '

line.comment: * Mordan8 - added back lasers. (Add-Ons 1.14: Shields are back.)
* Expanded 2.2.1: Recycling ship sorting.
* 0 = Displayed name A-Z.
* 1 = Ship model A-Z, then displayed name.
* Append ship and its sorting key together.
* Both arrays remain aligned despite reverse iteration.
* Sort the matching ship/key arrays.
* MSCI for each traverses the sorted array from tail to head.
* Reverse it so the menu displays ascending A-Z.
* Bootiful kode!
* Mordan8 - added back lasers. (Add-Ons 1.14: Shields are back.)
* Mordan2, add Chaff to recycle menu. Apparently it's not considered a tradeable ware so won't be in the list of missiles.
* Missile (l), #(r), Silicon Wafer(r)
* + Selected(l)
* Mordan2, change heading to right alignment for "Selected" entry so it lines up nicely.
* gosub AppendHeading:
* qty = amount in the station at present
* current = amount you wish to sell.
* Aurora Missile(l), 20(r), 544(r)
* Mordan2, change line to right alignment for the selected fraction display so it lines up.
* gosub AppendLine:
* Add the trade bar
* Expanded 2.2.1: Shared manual recycling eligibility.
* Ships already being recycled cannot be selected again.
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: Don't need current and total supply if recycling.
* $heading = columnize menu text: array= $heading, text= 'Stock', alignment= -1, colour= 0, column width= 150
* Add-Ons 1.2: Changed alignment from -1 to +1
* $line = columnize menu text: array= $line, text= $qty, alignment= -1, colour= 0, column width= 150
* Add-Ons 1.2: Changed alignment from -1 to +1
